meaning.en: To watch intently without moving one's eyes.
meaning.zh: 眼珠一动不动地盯着看，形容注意力集中。

examples.zh: 孩子们目不转睛地看着魔术表演。
examples.en: The children watched the magic show without taking their eyes off it.

examples.zh: 他目不转睛地盯着屏幕上的股价。
examples.en: He stared intently at the share prices on the screen.

examples.zh: 观众目不转睛，生怕错过精彩瞬间。
examples.en: The audience were glued to the action, afraid to miss a moment.

usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“目不转睛地看着”。

meaning.en: To live together in peace without conflict.
meaning.zh: 彼此相处平安，没有冲突。

examples.zh: 两家做了多年邻居，一直相安无事。
examples.en: The two families have been neighbours for years without any trouble.

examples.zh: 只要互不干涉，大家就能相安无事。
examples.en: As long as nobody interferes, everyone can get along fine.

meaning.en: To live in harmony with others without blindly agreeing with them.
meaning.zh: 与人和睦相处，但不盲目附和。

examples.zh: 团队合作要和而不同，敢于提出不同意见。
examples.en: Good teamwork means harmony without uniformity: daring to voice a different view.

examples.zh: 各国文化应当和而不同、相互尊重。
examples.en: Different cultures should coexist in harmony while respecting their differences.

story.en: Confucius: 'The gentleman seeks harmony but not sameness; the petty man seeks sameness but not harmony.'
story.zh: 《论语》：“君子和而不同，小人同而不和。”

usage.en: Predicate or object; formal, common in essays and diplomacy.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常用于议论文和外交辞令。

meaning.en: Delighting in doing good and generous in giving to others.
meaning.zh: 喜欢做善事，乐于拿财物接济别人。

examples.zh: 这位老企业家乐善好施，资助了很多贫困学生。
examples.en: The old entrepreneur is very charitable and has sponsored many poor students.

examples.zh: 村里人都知道他乐善好施。
examples.en: Everyone in the village knows how generous he is.

meaning.en: Whether the people support or oppose something.
meaning.zh: 人民群众的拥护或反对。

examples.zh: 人心向背决定了政权的兴亡。
examples.en: Whether the people support it decides the rise or fall of a regime.

examples.zh: 这场改革的成败取决于人心向背。
examples.en: The success of this reform depends on public support.

usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，庄重语体。

meaning.en: Of no importance; not mattering.
meaning.zh: 不重要，不影响大局。

examples.zh: 这些细节无关紧要，先别管它。
examples.en: These details don't matter; leave them for now.

examples.zh: 他总爱问一些无关紧要的问题。
examples.en: He's always asking trivial questions.

meaning.en: The dead find peace only once buried.
meaning.zh: 人死后埋葬了，才算安心，多用于丧葬。

examples.zh: 老人临终前希望早日入土为安。
examples.en: Before he died, the old man hoped to be laid to rest soon.

examples.zh: 按照习俗，逝者要尽快入土为安。
examples.en: By custom, the dead should be buried as soon as possible.

meaning.en: Completely unarmed.
meaning.zh: 手里没有任何武器。

examples.zh: 歹徒竟向手无寸铁的平民开枪。
examples.en: The gunmen opened fire on unarmed civilians.

examples.zh: 他手无寸铁，却勇敢地冲上去制止抢劫。
examples.en: Unarmed, he bravely rushed in to stop the robbery.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; often 手无寸铁的平民/百姓.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，常说“手无寸铁的百姓”。

meaning.en: To argue firmly on the strength of reason.
meaning.zh: 依据道理，尽力争辩或争取。

examples.zh: 谈判中，他据理力争，为公司争取到了更好的条件。
examples.en: In the negotiations he argued firmly and won the company better terms.

examples.zh: 面对不公平的判罚，教练据理力争。
examples.en: Faced with an unfair decision, the coach stood his ground.

meaning.en: The trip was not in vain; well worth the journey.
meaning.zh: 这次出行没有白跑，很有收获。

examples.zh: 这次参观收获很大，真是不虚此行。
examples.en: We learned a lot on this visit; it was well worth the trip.

examples.zh: 看到了日出，大家都觉得不虚此行。
examples.en: Having seen the sunrise, everyone felt the trip had been worth it.

usage.en: Predicate; often 真是不虚此行.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“真是不虚此行”。

meaning.en: To grant every request.
meaning.zh: 只要有人请求，就一定答应。

examples.zh: 他对朋友有求必应。
examples.en: He never turns down a friend who asks for help.

examples.zh: 父母对孩子不能有求必应。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't give children everything they ask for.

meaning.en: To rack one's brains (often for an unworthy aim).
meaning.zh: 费尽心机，想尽办法，多含贬义。

examples.zh: 骗子挖空心思设计各种陷阱。
examples.en: Scammers go to great lengths to devise all sorts of traps.

examples.zh: 商家挖空心思吸引顾客。
examples.en: Shops rack their brains for ways to draw in customers.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate; often mildly negative.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，多含贬义。

meaning.en: Completely exposed, with nothing hidden.
meaning.zh: 完全暴露出来，没有一点遗留。

examples.zh: 他的野心暴露无遗。
examples.en: His ambition was laid bare.

examples.zh: 这场比赛把球队防守的问题暴露无遗。
examples.en: The match exposed every weakness in the team's defence.

meaning.en: To flatly deny.
meaning.zh: 一口咬定，坚决不承认。

examples.zh: 面对证据，他仍然矢口否认。
examples.en: Even faced with the evidence, he flatly denied it.

examples.zh: 这位官员矢口否认收受贿赂。
examples.en: The official categorically denied taking bribes.

meaning.en: Left exactly as it was; untouched.
meaning.zh: 原来的封口没有动过，比喻保持原样，一点不变。

examples.zh: 礼物原封不动地退了回去。
examples.en: The present was sent back unopened.

examples.zh: 他把老师的话原封不动地转告给了同学。
examples.en: He passed the teacher's words on to his classmates word for word.

examples.zh: 房间里的摆设原封不动。
examples.en: The room was left just as it was.

meaning.en: Beyond compare.
meaning.zh: 没有可以相比的。

examples.zh: 这里的风景有着无可比拟的魅力。
examples.en: The scenery here has an incomparable charm.

examples.zh: 这款芯片的性能无可比拟。
examples.en: The chip's performance is second to none.

meaning.en: Time and again; repeatedly.
meaning.zh: 形容次数很多，多次。

examples.zh: 我三番五次提醒他，他还是忘了。
examples.en: I reminded him time and again, but he still forgot.

examples.zh: 他三番五次上门道歉。
examples.en: He came round to apologise again and again.

meaning.en: To climb high and gaze into the distance; (fig.) to take a broad, far-sighted view.
meaning.zh: 登上高处向远处眺望，比喻眼光远大。

equivalents: take in the view from on high

examples.zh: 重阳节，人们有登高望远的习俗。
examples.en: At the Double Ninth Festival, people traditionally climb high and look out into the distance.

examples.zh: 做规划要登高望远，不能只看眼前。
examples.en: Planning requires a far-sighted view, not just looking at what's in front of you.

meaning.en: As fixed as a nail driven into a board; settled beyond doubt.
meaning.zh: 在木板上钉钉子，比喻事情已经定了，不能改变。

examples.zh: 他升职的事已经板上钉钉了。
examples.en: His promotion is a done deal.

examples.zh: 这事还没板上钉钉，先别声张。
examples.en: It isn't set in stone yet, so keep it quiet.

usage.en: Predicate; often 已经板上钉钉了.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“已经板上钉钉了”。

meaning.en: Completely satisfied.
meaning.zh: 心里十分满足。

examples.zh: 吃上一碗热面，他就心满意足了。
examples.en: A hot bowl of noodles is all it takes to make him perfectly content.

examples.zh: 孩子拿到新玩具，心满意足地睡了。
examples.en: With his new toy, the child went to sleep completely satisfied.

meaning.en: Present everywhere; ubiquitous.
meaning.zh: 没有哪里不存在，形容到处都有。

examples.zh: 在今天，手机几乎无所不在。
examples.en: Today mobile phones are practically ubiquitous.

examples.zh: 压力无所不在，关键是学会调节。
examples.en: Stress is everywhere; the key is learning to manage it.

meaning.en: To sum it up in a word.
meaning.zh: 用一句话来概括。

examples.zh: 一言以蔽之，这个方案成本太高。
examples.en: In a word, the plan costs too much.

examples.zh: 他的成功经验，一言以蔽之，就是坚持。
examples.en: The secret of his success, in a word, is perseverance.

story.en: Confucius on the Book of Songs: 'Its three hundred poems can be summed up in one phrase: no depraved thoughts.'
story.zh: 《论语》：“《诗》三百，一言以蔽之，曰：‘思无邪’。”

usage.zh: 多用在句首或作插入语，书面语。

meaning.en: Every movement and gesture; one's bearing.
meaning.zh: 一抬手，一动脚，指人的一举一动。

examples.zh: 她举手投足间透着优雅。
examples.en: Grace shows in her every gesture.

examples.zh: 这位演员举手投足都很有分寸。
examples.en: Every move the actor makes is well judged.

usage.en: Subject or adverbial; often 举手投足间.
usage.zh: 多作主语、状语，常说“举手投足间”。

meaning.en: Turbulent and unsettled.
meaning.zh: 局势不稳定，不平静。

examples.zh: 那个地区局势动荡不安。
examples.en: The situation in that region is turbulent.

examples.zh: 在动荡不安的年代，他们背井离乡。
examples.en: In those troubled times, they left their homes.

meaning.en: To look around in all directions.
meaning.zh: 这里看看，那里望望，形容到处张望。

examples.zh: 上课时他总是东张西望。
examples.en: He's always looking around in class.

examples.zh: 她站在站台上东张西望，寻找来接她的人。
examples.en: She stood on the platform looking about for whoever was meeting her.
